messages.author: Vlad Cojocaru
messages.body:
Dear all,
Does anyone have experience with using the ff19SB force field with the
OPC3 water model ? If yes, could you comment briefly on accuracy
compared to the recommended ff19SB+OPC but also ff14SB+TIP3P ? A
literature search did not get me too far in answering this. Any relevant
reference I may have missed would also be very much appreciated.
Thanks a lot for any insights
Best wishes
Vlad
-- 
Dr. Vlad Cojocaru (PD, Habil.)

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
Hi Vlad,
Yes we have done some tests using opc3, nothing published yet. For peptides
the match to experiment degrades a little compared to opc, but better than
tip3p. I don't have more specifics since I am at the ACS meeting this week.
Carlos
